title: inventory gate-rewritten committed artifacts (pinned JSON, generated translations, ledgers) with 7-day overlaps and a destination each (hot-file card C)
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRsWwTRkuRCyQwvpAG

Filing gate ③: maintainer-directed. On 2026-11-15 the maintainer chose 「今天改规则,并立全部 6 张卡」 on the hot-file serialization decision card (consequence as shown: 取消 protocol.ts 独占、关闭 #25467 和 #24586;卡 A 到 F 交各车道立卡,大 PR 和上限门禁仍逐个等您批准). Measurements: the hot-file analysis report (project artifact), re-runnable on request. Cross-lane rule (2026-11-15): no live seat in the owning lane, so `domain:server` seat 5 files and builds it; the owning lane is notified.

## Card C (owning lane: devx)

Inventory every committed artifact that a gate makes PRs rewrite (e.g. `engine-double-contract.pinned.json`, platform-objects `*.generated.ts` translations, count ledgers).

For each: path, the gate that rewrites it, PR touches in the last 7 days, measured textual overlaps among them, and a destination: not committed (generated in CI), sharded, or an os-regen merge driver. Deliverable: a report on this card plus one follow-up card per artifact whose destination is not "leave". No code in this card.
